v3Dependency: Verify original frozen byte SHA256, import selector and pair_identity without copying/modifying. V4 replaces source-purpose authorization only.
ordering: Exact v3 first_topologies: dataset, recordingId lexical then chronological first eligible occurrence. Batik recordingId is performance MIDI basename without extension, from metadata-batik.csv.
truthGrouping: Exact v3 select_truth.read_midi: first NOTE_ON anchor <=35ms, non-transitive, velocity-zero note-on is note-off. All pitches count for no-new-note guard.
pairIdentity: Exact v3 pair_identity; for unacquired Batik audio audioSha256 is explicitly null, NOT invented. Canonical truth pairId binds this null plus exact MIDI, gestures and onsets; a separate immutable sourceAudioIdentity binds upstream Git blob SHA1 and metadata row. It is not an acoustic-byte identity. Future audio acquisition requires an additional prospective identity freeze.
durationBeforeAudio: Use performance MIDI end-of-track duration as symbolic performance extent for the unchanged selector durationMs field. Record provenance explicitly; this is not measured audio duration or acoustic context/alignment validation. Future acquisition must verify real pre/future context and input preservation. No audio suitability claim.
midiParseGate: Corrected Vienna baseline must equal all nine expected counts. Hash all downloaded MIDI bytes without parsing. Freeze metadata, provenance, source-purpose ledger, history probe, tooling and exact dependency hashes; commit, push, fetch, exact remote SHA verify. Only then parse Batik musical events.
historyProbe: Full non-shallow local Git object closure reachable from --all refs at starting HEAD, plus current tracked reports and repository project work files. Search identity tokens in metadata/text blobs; return only identity hits and object/path witnesses, never acoustic values. Include deleted and renamed historical text blobs; scan binary MIDI by byte SHA. Probe dataset identity, recording/MIDI/audio basenames and paths, MIDI SHA256 and future audio Git SHA1. Unknown/incomplete fails closed. Newly generated v4 artifacts do not count as prior exposure.
historyHitPolicy: Any candidate identity hit in pre-existing history/work requires independent identity/provenance classification before freeze; no automatic fresh label. Unresolved hits UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE exclude. No selected candidate is exempt from history probe.
audioGate: No external audio bytes, no PCM decoding, no neural runs, no Continuous regression this phase. Git tree metadata only may bind future audio blob identity/size.
onMissing: STEP_WAITING_H50_EXTERNAL_BATIK_TRUTH_TOPOLOGY_INCOMPLETE; stop without changed rules, another dataset, audio or inference.
onComplete: STEP_WAITING_H50_EXTERNAL_TRUTH_TOPOLOGY_COMPLETE_AUDIO_ACQUISITION_NOT_STARTED; freeze combined truth topology only then stop. Not PRIMARY QUALIFIED or H50 QUALIFIED.
counterfactualsAndScoring: Exact immutable v3 scorer-contract and selector-contract retained; no scorer changes and no product scoring executed now. Metadata opportunities are never READY/BUSY/ACOUSTIC PASS.
